version.changelog:
Initial release – generate professional, customizable PDF intake forms for pet sitters and related businesses.

- Supports fillable PDFs with interactive fields and multiple color themes.
- Allows generating custom forms for various services (boarding, walking, drop-ins) and multi-pet households.
- Includes dedicated sections for home access, health, behavior, and service-specific needs.
- Offers CLI and YAML config support for streamlined and repeatable form creation.
- Easily share print-ready or digital forms with clients, branded to your business.

llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it says — generate local, branded PDF intake forms — and its requested permissions and files are appropriate, but it collects sensitive customer data (alarm codes, Wi‑Fi passwords, etc.) and part of the generator code was truncated in the package review, so you should review the script before running it in a production environment.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included assets: a Python script plus docs to produce fillable PDF intake forms. Required permissions (filesystem, shell) and declared dependencies (reportlab, pyyaml) are consistent with PDF generation and optional YAML config loading.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped to collecting form fields and running the included Python script to generate a PDF. However the form explicitly asks for highly sensitive homeowner information (alarm/disarm codes, Wi‑Fi password, key locations). That is coherent with the stated 'home access' feature but is a privacy/security risk to consider before entering real secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec — instruction-only invocation plus included scripts. Dependencies are standard Python packages (reportlab, pyyaml) referenced in requirements.txt. Nothing in the manifest pulls code from untrusted URLs or uses extract/install steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or external credentials; that is proportional for a local PDF generator. Note: sensitive data is requested as form inputs (home access details) rather than via env vars. No evidence the skill requires unrelated credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal agent invocation are used. Declared permissions (filesystem + shell) are appropriate for running the bundled script and writing the generated PDF. The skill does not request to modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package is internally consistent for generating local PDF intake forms, but review and use caution before providing highly sensitive information (alarm codes, Wi‑Fi passwords, key locations) to any form. Recommended steps before installing/using: 1) Inspect scripts/generate_form.py yourself (or run it in an isolated environment) to ensure there are no unexpected network calls, telemetry, or file writes outside the chosen output path; the provided file was truncated in the review so a full review is advised. 2) Install dependencies in a virtualenv (pip install -r requirements.txt). 3) Prefer entering placeholder data for home access fields until you confirm the script only writes to the intended output. 4) Keep generated PDFs in a secure location and avoid storing passwords in plaintext inside shared config files. 5) If you need stricter guarantees, run the script offline on a machine you control and audit the full source before supplying real secrets.
